title: Integral-closedness part of Stacks Tag 037D.
statement: For a filtered diagram of commutative rings whose localizations at all primes are integrally closed domains, the localization of the colimit at any prime is integrally closed.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma Tag 037D (lemma-colimit-normal-ring), stated there for a directed system; a filtered colimit is a directed colimit by Categories, Lemma Tag 0032 (categories-lemma-directed-category-system). Used in More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 06DI.

proof.text: Use localization at the contracted primes to obtain a filtered localization diagram and a colimit cocone with point the localization of the original colimit. Each stage is an integrally closed domain by the hypothesis. Apply the common-stage integrally closedness theorem with the colimit witness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 037D, common-stage normal-domain argument, implemented with Mathlib filtered-colimit and scaleRoots APIs

statement_change.what: Restore the normal-domain assumptions of Tag 037D. The common-stage Lean statement also omitted IsColimit c, so originally any cocone from Z would falsely force its point to be integrally closed. The localized conclusion is now restricted to the domain case used by the parent normal-ring theorem, whose statement is unchanged. The stronger integral-closedness-only generalization is not proved or silently reused.
